messages:
mira: Quick sync followup: propose a tiny cross-language primitive (SessionHandle) to unify resume/retry/pagination across Python/TS/Go.
mira: Problem: each SDK uses different resume token shape and retry wiring -> flaky interop tests and divergent behavior.
	sam: +1. Keep continuation opaque and let transports own format. SDKs must not parse tokens.

chen: SessionHandle sketch:
	- resume(opts) -> { items, continuation?, more? }
	- checkpoint() -> opaque base64 token
	- close()
	- hints() -> small map (route_hint, approx_size)

pat: Retry model: caller supplies RetrySpec; transport returns signals: TRANSIENT, THROTTLED, PERMANENT, UNKNOWN. SDK WithRetry decides. UNKNOWN => conservative no-retry unless idempotency key present.

mira: Streaming: resume(streaming=true) yields incremental chunks; same handle covers page & stream modes.

sam: Telemetry: hints() provides non-sensitive attribution for Console. Continuations must not contain pod ids or secrets; SDK logs and drops if detected.

pat: Migration plan: add SessionHandle experimental; implement python adapter first; add cross-lang compatibility tests; deprecate old API after 2 releases. devops-bot: canary matrix added ENG-SDK-2401.

chen: Action items: mira draft RFC + python adapter, sam build WithRetry helper, pat document transport signal mappings.

mira: I'll open the draft RFC and the test matrix. Thanks.
